TransactionJournal.name: TransactionJournal
TransactionJournal.description: Represents consumption details of a usage resource that are recorded for creating usage summaries.

AccountId.description: The account associated with the consumption.

ActivityDate.description: Required. The date of the transaction.

ErrorDescription.description: The description of the error in the journal record.

ExternalTransactionNumber.description: The transaction number from the external systems.

InvoiceDate.description: The date the invoice was generated.

LastReferencedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user referenced this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user viewed this record.

MemberId.description: The rebate program member associated with this record. Note Use this field if you have enabled Rebate Management in your org and the dealer submitting the transaction is part of a rebate program.

Name.description: The autogenerated number of the transaction journal.

OrderId.description: The order associated with the transaction.

OrderItemId.description: The order items associated with the transaction.

ProductCategoryId.description: The category of the product associated with the transaction.

ProductId.description: The product associated with the transaction.

QuantityUnitOfMeasureId.description: The unit of measure for the associated usage resource.

RebatePgmReferenceNumber.description: The reference number of the rebate program in which the dealer is enrolled. Note Use this field if you have enabled Rebate Management in your org and the dealer submitting the transaction is part of a rebate program.

ReferenceRecordId.description: The asset associated with the transaction journal.

ShipToAccountId.description: The customer or partner account associated with the transaction.

TradedFromAccountId.description: The account of the dealer who sells a product to another dealer or distributor who further fulfills the final demand.

TradedToAccountId.description: The account of the dealer who purchases a product from another dealer or distributor to complete their inventory requirement.

TransactionAmount.description: The total amount of the transaction.

Status.description: Required. The status of the transaction.

Origin.description: The starting location for a trip or the place where an order is shipped from.

Destination.description: The ending location for a trip or the place where an order shipped to.

Distance.description: The miles or kilometers traveled or an order's shipping distance.

BookedFareClass.description: The class of ticket service booked.

BookingDate.description: The booking date of a reservation or purchase.

StartDate.description: The start date associated with the transaction.

EndDate.description: The end date associated with the transaction.

PaymentMethod.description: The payment method of the purchase.

PartnerId.description: Participating partners where loyalty program members can add or redeem points.

Establishment.description: The unique identifier for the purchase.

Industry.description: Specifies the type of the industry.

ReferredMemberId.description: The name of the person the loyalty program member referred.

RelatedCorporateMembershipId.description: The corporate membership associated with the transaction.

RelatedJournalId.description: The related journal entry associated with this transaction.

LoyaltyProgramId.description: The loyalty program associated with the transaction.

CurrencyIsoCode.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the monetary currency in which the transaction took place.

CouponId.description: The coupon that's applied as a part of a promotion to provide discounts on the transaction. This field is available in API version 66.0 and later.

EngagementChannelTypeId.description: The ID of the engagement channel used for the purchase. This field is available in API version 61.0 and later.

EscrowPointsCreditDate.description: The date on which the escrow points are credited to the associated loyalty program member's point balance. This field is available in API version 53.0 and later.

IsParentTransaction.description: Indicates whether the transaction journal represents the primary activity within a group of activities. This field is available in API version 60.0 and later.

JournalReason.description: Specifies the reason for the journal record.

PromotionId.description: The promotion associated with the transaction journal. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

RedeemedPointsExpirationInformation.description: The details of the fixed type non-qualifying points that are redeemed in a transaction journal and their corresponding expiration dates. This field is available in API version 55.0 and later.RedeemedPointsExpirationInformation isn't able in the Object Manager and can't be customized.

ReferredPartyId.description: The ID of the contact or account associated with the transaction journal. The contact ID belongs to the person whose activity the transaction journal represents. This field is available in API version 60.0 and later.

TotalPromotionDiscount.description: The total discount provided by the associated promotion for the activity that the transaction journal represents. This field is available in API version 61.0 and later.

TransactionSourceLocationId.description: The ID of the retail store where the activity that the transaction journal represents has taken place. This field is available in API version 60.0 and later.

Unique Identifier.description: The unique identifier of the transaction journal.

VoucherCode.description: The voucher code generated by an external system.

AccountingModelConfigName.description: The name of the accounting set.

Comment.description: The description of the transaction journal record.

DueDate.description: The date when the transaction is due.

FundAccountRecordIdValue.description: The value of the fund account record identifier.

FundAccountValue.description: The value of the fund account.

GeneralLedgerCode.description: The code of the associated general ledger.

IsAccrualJournalEntry.description: Determines whether the record is an accrual journal entry (true) or not (false).

IsAdjustmentJournalEntry.description: Determines whether the record is an adjustment journal entry (true) or not (false).

IsHistoricalJournalEntry.description: Determines whether the record is a historical journal entry (true) or not (false).

IsRelatedJournalEntry.description: Determines whether the record is a related journal entry (true) or not (false).

IsWriteOffJournalEntry.description: Determines whether the record is a write-off journal entry (true) or not (false).

PrimaryRecordIdValue.description: The value of the primary record identifier.

SecondaryRecordIdValue.description: The value of the secondary record identifier.

CreationSourceType.description: Specifies how the transaction journal was created.

OfferId.description: The offer that's used to provide promotional discount on the transaction. This field is available in API version 66.0 and later

UniqueIdentifier.description: The unique identifier of the transaction journal.

UsageResourceId.description: The usage resource that's associated with the transaction journal.

UsageSummaryId.description: The usage summary that's associated with the transaction journal. Available in API version 64.0 and later.

TransactionJournal.accessRules: You must have the Usage Management Run Time permission set license.
